tbesh_html:
§ Ophir = "reducing to ashes"
a land or city in southern Arabia in Solomon's trade route where gold evidently was traded for goods

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Ophir, the name of a son of Joktan, and of a gold region in the East
strongs_1890.derivation: or (shortened) אֹפִיר; and אוֹפִר; of uncertain derivation;
